newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain stocks up 1.3 pct in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain stocks up 1.3 pct in moderate trade.

text.p: Share index on the Bahrain Stock Exchange climbed 21.81 points, or 1.3 percent, in the week to Thursday in moderate turnover focused on bank shares, official figures showed.
The exchange said the index climbed to 1,749.13 points from 1,727.32 points the previous week.
More than 9.7 million shares worth 2.6 million dinars ($6.9 million) were traded in the week compared with 10.8 million shares worth 3.5 million dinars a week earlier.
Shares of 28 of the 40 firms listed on the exchange changed hands in 458 transactions.
The bourse said 447,675 shares of Investcorp worth 369,622 dinars were traded this week. Its share price closed on Thursday six U.S. cents up to $2.18 each.
The exchange said 703,166 shares of National Bank of Bahrain worth 295,739 dinars changed hands. The bank's share prices ended the week at 422 fils each, up four fils on a week earlier.
Bahrain Middle East Bank gained one fils to 141 fils each and Bahrain International Bank rose three fils to 186 fils each. ($1 = 0.377 dinar) -- Bahrain newsroom 973-524424.
